name: Launcher - e2e_feature_inventory_minimax_20261029
purpose: Launch ONE separate Reasonix session that (a) runs all 82 browser_e2e suites live against the unpacked MV3 extension with full-video capture, (b) sends each feature's full video to MiniMax-3.1-Flash via the official MiniMax API for certification, (c) writes the verdict. Sequential (POOL_SIZE=1) by deliberation decision - the certifier is ONE seat (operator directive).
launcher_kind: single-session sequential (deliberation/ADOPTED candidate A; candidate B fleet pool REJECTED on AC-6 singular-seat + AC-2 bundle-split)
operator_actions_required: start one fresh Reasonix session (separate chat/session) against this repo
paste the LAUNCH-PROMPT.md body as the session's task

the session needs the unpacked extension path (it builds the video-capturing launcher itself from test/browser_e2e/_helpers/dom.js's launchExtensionContext) and the project's official MiniMax API credential (first-party minimax family already integrated in vendor/relay/model_catalog.py)
wait for the session to commit verdict.md + progress.jsonl (or a partial verdict if it paused mid-run)
relaunch and re-paste the same prompt to resume from progress.jsonl's last row
safeguards: session must not modify js/**, manifest.json, or any EXISTING test file (AC-4 aborts on any)
new launcher/videography code lives ONLY under this track's execution/ directory
certifier is MiniMax via the official API only; a RED suite is reported, never patched
the requested model id 'minimax 3.1 flash' must be pinned to the real official-api model name at Phase 0, with the resolution (or mismatch) recorded
